messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated errors and throttles on route r/embeds/customer_hot (prod). 5xx rate +18% over baseline, P95 latency up, QPS ~4x usual. Paging on-call @sara.
sara: ACK — joining. Is this customer-facing or internal batch?
ben: joining from infra. Looks like a burst from partner-shop's anonymous traffic; a lot of embed batches with big payloads.
sara: preliminary: identify top routes + offending API keys. ben can you grab top-20 by QPS?
ben: pulling now. link: https://monitoring.internal/graph?m=r/embeds/customer_hot top callers: partner-shop (60%), retail-ml (20%), misc anonymous (20%).
sara: OK. mitigation options: soft QPS cap per-route, move embeddings to low-priority pool, disable rerank for this route, and enable prefix caching. Want to apply soft caps first to avoid hard failures.
ben: plan I will execute (in order):
1) soft-cap r/embeds/customer_hot -> 50 QPS
2) set route priority -> low
3) disable rerank on that route
4) boost cache TTL for common prefix keys
5) notify CS & comms.
sara: run cmds pls and paste outputs.
ben: running:
```
# soft throttle
redwoodctl routes throttle set r/embeds/customer_hot --qps 50 --mode soft
# lower priority pool
redwoodctl routes set-priority r/embeds/customer_hot --priority low
# disable rerank for route
redwoodctl feature-toggle set rerank false --route r/embeds/customer_hot
```
ben: commands executed — throttle applied (50qps soft), priority changed, rerank toggled off. Incident-runbook: https://wiki.internal/incidents/INF-XXX
incident-bot: ACTIONS APPLIED: throttle=50qps (soft), priority=low, rerank=disabled. Telemetry will reflect within ~2m.
laura: CS here — I'll draft status note for partner-shop + retail-ml and post to status page. Any customer-visible errors expected?
sara: some 429s likely for anonymous bulk jobs; chat flows unaffected (separate route). Inform partners to backoff.
mike: FYI I'll be on shift handoff in ~10m, can take over monitoring then.
sara: handing to @mike in 10m. Notes: logs -> https://logs.internal/streams?route=r/embeds/customer_hot, runbook section: Live quota surgery. If errors persist >10m, escalate to hard cap 30qps and consider region failover.
mike: ACK — I'll keep soft cap for 15m, watch error budget, and start restore if p95 & 5xx improve for two consecutive windows. I'll also schedule rollback script if things regress.
ben: quick note for follow-up: current routing conflates embed + rerank on same endpoint. Propose a route-split to apply per-endpoint quotas separately (embed vs rerank). I'll file INF-842 and own it.
laura: status page update posted to customers — included recommended backoff and ETA for next update in 30m.
incident-bot: METRICS: 5xx down to baseline, p95 latency improving, QPS reduced to ~1.1x baseline after throttle.
sara: thanks everyone — leaving monitoring to @mike. Handed over at 1955556721.
mike: monitoring green at t+8m, continuing watch. Will open follow-up ticket for split quotas and permanent rate-limits.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED for now — actions: INF-842 created for permanent route-split and per-endpoint quota, owner ben; CS follow-ups assigned to laura. If symptoms reappear reopen incident. :white_check_mark:
